role: Gate: replays the oracle's PotionProbe dump (living spawns, then scripted events: add potion effect, clear effects, eat food, throw a splash potion) through csrc/engine/potion.c and living.c, comparing every entity field, NBT, removal and Det digest after each tick.

structs.java: one Det split stream (determinize.sh static RNG name) per role

structs.name: ref
structs.java: the oracle's Det start.txt/end.txt snapshot (netherite.oracle.Det: world seed, per-role nextId, seeder/math digests, split streams)

gpu: lines 687, 879, 1001: getenv(AN_LIST / AN_DEBUG) debug prints (harness only)
notes: Test harness, built with -Dmain=gate_test_main behind tests/input_guard.c; not linked into the product and never on the tick path. make -C csrc test runs it on every directory under out/java/potions. Native calls: living_add_potion_effect, living_clear_active_potions, potion_apply_food (csrc/engine/potion.h), an_spawn_potion, an_spawn_living, an_init/an_tick/an_free, living_nbt_text/hash, item_entity_nbt_text/hash, world_*, det_*, nbt_*. Skips a dump whose kind is not potions. The file header still describes the AnimalProbe (copied from test_animals); the manifest kind is potions and the oracle side is oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/PotionProbe.java. Recordings: out/java/potions/seed2, seed42.
